draftNote: legacy-fix r1 草稿（Hark-QUA 2026-11-21，未审）：配合 drill-anim/specs/s-9090-lfx1.js（左右换髋往返）。原 Hub 文字 catalog/production/v3-text/s-9090.json（单侧前倾静态保持，开哥 r2 决定）未改。用哪一版（换髋重做 / 保留单侧前倾改名）需开哥选。

purpose.zh: 活动两侧髋关节的内旋和外旋
purpose.en: Moves both hips through internal and external rotation.

text.zh: 脚跟压稳，双膝一起翻到另一侧
text.en: Heels planted, turn both knees over to the other side

text.zh: 上身尽量坐直，别往后靠
text.en: Sit as tall as you can, don't lean back

text.zh: 两边都落成 90/90：前腿小腿横在身前，后腿小腿朝后
text.en: Land in 90/90 each side: front shin across, back shin pointing back

text.zh: 膝盖跟着髋转，别硬拧膝盖
text.en: Let the hips turn the knees; don't twist at the knee

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼就缩小翻转幅度或手撑在身后辅助，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your knees hurt, turn less or put your hands behind you. Stop if it still hurts.

training.source: legacy-fix-r1 draft (Flare 热身文案：脚跟压稳，双膝翻到另一侧，上身尽量坐直)
